text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer comes to an end. For Durandal, it 
appeared to be a fun and fulfilling summer 
on the surface, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This summer, through intensive training 
alongside Right O-san and Believe-san... I 
finally realized it."
choice_data_list: え、申し訳ないって……何が？

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Just how perilous my sprinting really is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I chase, that back 
stays out of reach... As expected, 
sprinting is...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Running flat out from the start offers a 
huge advantage. If she relies solely on 
her late-race sprint, there's a high 
chance she won't be able to cut through in 
time...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps if I had abandoned my running 
style, there might have been another way 
forward, but..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for... causing you trouble. 
Knowing that I'm putting such a burden on 
you is just so frustrating and pathetic...
choice_data_list: No, you're not a nuisance at all!
No, you're not bothering me at all!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: いや、迷惑なんてことはないよ！
ううん、迷惑なんてことはないよ！
choice_data_list_en: No, you're not a nuisance at all!
No, it's no trouble at all!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono... Your words... are deeply 
appreciated...
choice_data_list: 『聖剣』は君だけの大切な武器だから！
『聖剣』は貴方だけの大切な武器だから！
choice_data_list_en: Because the 'Holy Sword' is your precious weapon and yours alone!
Because that 'Holy Sword' is your precious weapon, and yours alone!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Your presence is a great 
support and encouragement to me.
choice_data_list: こっちこそ何も助けてあげられず、ごめん
choice_data_list_en: I'm the one who's sorry for not being able to help at all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to devote myself to making 
your future even the slightest bit more 
brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Durandal says so, but as for myself..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Fine Motion taught me dignity, was 
I able to give anything in return to 
Durandal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I haven't done anything truly 
great for her yet—despite how utterly 
devoted she is to me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, even so, for the upcoming Centaur 
Stakes, I wish to at least...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I just want to show the potential. The 
potential that from next year onwards, I 
can surely contend even in Sprint GⅠ 
races.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a GII, Senior-class 
Umamusume will also be running in the 
Centaur Stakes. We can't afford to be 
optimistic at all.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fierce competition of sprinting. I 
want to do anything I can to help Durandal 
through it all.
